text:
Situation: Esmolol hydrochloride 100 mg/10 mL is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 214 vials (19.9 days on hand at 10.7 vials per day). Corvale General holds 386 vials (27.8 days on hand at 13.9 vials per day). The current labeler is Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (FEI 3014288534) with a VAI inspection classification dated 2024-09-11.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show esmolol hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers both sites for approximately 20 to 28 days. No shortage exists per FDA. The rule-based best option is to purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is also not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place. Baxter Healthcare Company, Baxter Healthcare Corporation, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC are similarly not on the shortage list but also name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Company as secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Eugia US LLC as fourth source; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as fifth source; requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or allocation restrictions at this time.
